exercises.instruction: Andy does these things every morning. What time does he do each thing?
items: Andy wakes up at seven o'clock. Then he (1) at five past seven. He
(2) at ten past seven and (3) at quarter past seven. At quarter to
eight he (4) and at half past eight he leaves the house and (5) .

exercises.instruction: Andy does these things every evening. What time does he do each thing?
items: Example: 5.00 finishes work

exercises.instruction: Here are pictures of Andy. What is he doing in each picture? Write sentences.
items: Example: Andy is leaving the office.

exercises.instruction: Write questions for these answers. Use either What time ...? or How often ...?
items: Example: Q: How often do you listen to the radio?
A: I listen to the radio every evening.
A: I go to work at 8.15.
A: I clean the house every Saturday.
A: I usually get up at 7 o'clock.
A: I go for a walk every evening.
A: I wash my clothes every week.
A: I usually go to bed at 11.30.
A: I go to the supermarket once a week.
A: I usually come home at 6.30.
A: I go to my friend's house every Friday evening.
A: I write a letter to my grandmother every Sunday.

boxesAndLists: finishes work [crossed out]  has dinner  watches TV  goes to bed  comes home  makes dinner
pictures: 6-panel picture strip with clock faces showing Andy's morning routine (bed, leaving house, bathroom, cereal, shower, alarm clock crossed out)
example picture: man with briefcase leaving an office door
10 numbered cartoon pictures (1-10) of Andy doing evening activities (watching TV, eating, cooking, sleeping, phone, reading, car, arriving home, waking)
unclassified: Test Your English Vocabulary in Use Elementary
